priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome (device_bash curl to OKX is blocked by the sandbox proxy allowlist -- exit 56/connect_rejected on both the cloud container and the local device shell).
priceSnapshot.note: Midday closed the handover at 84,308.7 (12:50 COT) after REDUCE fired on the settled 84,047.2 1H close, trimming the midnight tactical tranche back to the long-term core. Since then price ranged 83,717.1-84,666.6, printing a fresh local low before stabilizing around 83,900-84,300, and now sits at 83,977 -- essentially flat vs. the midday mark (-0.39%) and still below the 85,111.1 add/reclaim level. Neither the 83,500.2 reduce-confirmation level nor the 85,111.1 reclaim level has fired since midday. Open interest eased further to $2,490.3M (from $2,514.4M at midday, $2,655.7M at morning) -- a third consecutive session of OI decline, consistent with genuine deleveraging rather than fresh positioning building under the price.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 83,717.1 (this session's low) would confirm the range is breaking down toward the still-open 83,500.2 midday flush low.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back above 85,111.1 (unchanged since morning) would be the first confirmation this leg is repairing; a full reclaim of 85,325.2 restores the pre-pullback structure.

decisionBox.changed: Held the REDUCE-trimmed core stance; no reduce or add trigger fired overnight. Added a small, low-conviction spot DCA (12 USDT) into the core -- daily structure remains fully bullish (price above all four daily EMAs, RSI 63.65, MACD histogram still positive though decelerating), 1H RSI is near oversold (37.24) with the MACD histogram flipping positive (+6.36) for the first time since the flush, and the nearest liquidation magnet sits above spot (84,250, short liquidations, ~2.7x the size of the 83,750 long-liquidation cluster below) -- consistent with a small mean-reversion bid rather than continued breakdown. This is a core top-up, not a re-opening of the trimmed tactical size.

liquidation.note: Largest realized cluster in the freshness window: ~2.66 BTC notional (~$224k) of short liquidations bucketed at this price, ~5x the next-largest cluster.
~1.09 BTC notional (~$91k) of long liquidations bucketed here from the earlier flush.
~0.21 BTC notional (~$18k) of long liquidations, essentially at current spot.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public liquidation-orders API (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled, last 100 fills), aggregated into $250 price buckets. Newest fill 87 minutes old at fetch time -- within the freshness guard.
liquidityMagnet.note: Above-spot clusters (84,000/84,250/84,500) total ~3.0 BTC notional vs. ~1.09 BTC below spot at 83,750 -- liquidity is skewed toward pulling price up toward 84,250-84,500 on any short-covering move.
